en.d: From your homepage, scroll down to the rail called "N1 - Required Learning". In an ECNL club platform it's called "ECNL - Required Learning" — everything else works exactly the same.
Click the "N1 season 2026/2027" card to see everything that counts towards your certificate.
Inside you'll find three buckets: Core, Tactical and Technical modules. Together they add up to the 5 hours you need for your certificate.
Start here. All three core modules are required — that's your first 3 hours.
Hover over any module and click "Start". Each one shows its CPD value and length before you begin.

en.t: Tactical modules: complete one of three
en.d: Next, pick whichever tactical module suits you best — you only need to complete one of the three. That's your fourth hour.

en.t: Technical modules: complete one of three
en.d: Finally, do the same here: complete any one of the three technical modules. That's your fifth and final hour.

en.doneD: 3 core + 1 tactical + 1 technical = your full 5 required hours. Your certificate will be waiting in the "Achievements" section of your profile.
en.lead: For coaches in N1 and ECNL clubs. How to complete your 5 required hours and earn your certificate.
